=== PAGE 1 ===
THE ROBERT J. JOHNSON REVOCABLE LIVING TRUST
Dated June 2, 2021

DECLARATION OF TRUST
Robert J. Johnson, as Settlor and as Trustee, hereby declares that he holds and will hold the property described in Schedule A, and any property later transferred to the Trustee, in trust on the terms set forth in this instrument. This trust shall be known as THE ROBERT J. JOHNSON REVOCABLE LIVING TRUST.

ARTICLE 1. REVOCABILITY
During the Settlor's lifetime, the Settlor may revoke or amend this trust, in whole or in part, by a writing signed by the Settlor and delivered to the Trustee.

ARTICLE 2. TRUSTEES
Robert J. Johnson shall serve as the initial Trustee. Upon the death, resignation, or incapacity of Robert J. Johnson, his daughter Emily Johnson shall serve as successor trustee.

ARTICLE 3. TRUST PROPERTY
The brokerage account ending 4471 shall be held by and titled in the name of the Trust. The Settlor shall execute any documents necessary to retitle such account in the name of the Trustee.

=== PAGE 2 ===
ARTICLE 4. DISTRIBUTION ON DEATH OF SETTLOR
Upon the death of the Settlor, the Trustee shall distribute the remaining trust estate in equal shares to the Settlor's children, Emily Johnson, David Johnson and Sarah Johnson, outright and free of trust.

ARTICLE 5. INCAPACITY
The Settlor shall be considered incapacitated if two licensed physicians certify in writing that the Settlor is unable to manage his financial affairs prudently.

ARTICLE 6. GOVERNING LAW
The validity and construction of this trust shall be determined under the laws of the State of California.

Executed on June 2, 2021, at San Diego, California.

/s/ Robert J. Johnson
Robert J. Johnson, Settlor and Trustee

State of California, County of San Diego
On June 2, 2021, before me, Linda Park, Notary Public, personally appeared Robert J. Johnson, who proved to me on the basis of satisfactory evidence to be the person whose name is subscribed to the within instrument.
/s/ Linda Park, Notary Public
